description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945015584003 FLASHER,SOLID STATE: Line 0001 Qty 229 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
